% 12.12.2024 CRL.M.A.37460/2024 (Exemption)
1. Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.

2. The application stands disposed of.
W.P.(CRL) 3880/2024 1.

The instant petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 [earlier Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973] has been filed on behalf of the petitioners praying for quashing of FIR No.389/2020 dated 24th September, 2020, registered at Police Station Delhi Cantt., Delhi, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 2. Heard.

sentences.text: Learned ASC for the State appearing on advance notice accepted notice and vehemently opposed the instant petition.
Learned APP prayed for two weeks' time to file the status report.
Let the same be filed within two weeks as prayed.

4. Notice is also accepted by respondent No.2, who is present in Court and she submits that there is a 6-year old child of petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 who is in the custody of respondent No.2.

She further submits that she does not agree to the terms and conditions of the Memorandum of Understanding dated 29th April, 2023 which is annexed as Annexure B to the present petition as nothing has been given to her child in the said MoU.
5.
CHANDRA DHARI SINGH, J DECEMBER 12, 2024 Rt/st
